title: Ingress Controller Certificate Expiry — TLS 502/525 Errors
symptom: Clients report ERR_CERT_DATE_INVALID or TLS handshake failures; Nginx/Envoy access logs show 525 SSL Handshake Failed; cert-manager alerts firing for expired certificate.
recommended_action: kubectl delete secret <tls-secret-name> -n <namespace> && kubectl annotate certificate <cert-name> cert-manager.io/issue-temporary-certificate=true
remediation_steps: Identify expiring certificates: kubectl get certificates -A | grep False
Force cert-manager renewal: kubectl annotate certificate <name> cert-manager.io/issue-temporary-certificate=true --overwrite
Delete stale TLS secret to force re-issue: kubectl delete secret <tls-secret> -n <namespace>
